hypothesis: If POI Pocket overlay unmounts without dispatching isOpen: false in useEffect cleanup, AppShell isFullOverlayOpen remains true permanently, resulting in catastrophic UI freeze where BottomNav and top status buttons never recover.

In PoiPoolView.tsx, motion.div specifies hardcoded animate={{ height: 230 }}. Modifying Tailwind class h-80 sm:h-96 is ineffective because motion inline style height: 230px overrides CSS classes, preventing map enlargement.

When hiding top AIStatusButton and NotificationBell with opacity: 0, failing to set pointer-events: none and aria-hidden allows ghost clicks and keyboard navigation to trigger invisible buttons while interacting with the POI map.

Listening to tabidachi-full-overlay-change without strict type validation of event.detail.isOpen could cause state corruption if malformed CustomEvents are dispatched by other modules or browser extensions.
